## What

One line, the Conventional Commits title of the squash commit.

## Why

The ticket, incident or problem behind the change.

## Checks

- [ ] `just check` passes
- [ ] `kubedrill smoke <id>` passes for every variant (new or changed scenarios)
- [ ] Docs that describe the changed behavior are updated
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`-s` on the commit command)
